(* Computes Saturation Conditions, Enthalpies, Heat Fluxes, and Rankine Thermal Eff.     *)
(* Uses Antoine Relation: log10(P) = A - B / (T + C) ==> T = B / (A - log10(P)) - C      *)
(* In IEC 61131-3: log10(x) = LN(x) / 2.302585093                                       *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Evaporator Saturation Temperature Calculation from Voted Pressure *)
IF rVoted_Evaporator_Press > 1.0 THEN
    rEvap_Sat_Temp_Calc := (1113.928 / (4.8688 - (LN(rVoted_Evaporator_Press) / 2.302585093))) - 248.0;
ELSE
    rEvap_Sat_Temp_Calc := 21.0;
END_IF;

(* Condenser Saturation Temperature Calculation from Voted Pressure *)
IF rVoted_Condenser_Press > 0.5 THEN
    rCond_Sat_Temp_Calc := (1113.928 / (4.8688 - (LN(rVoted_Condenser_Press) / 2.302585093))) - 248.0;
ELSE
    rCond_Sat_Temp_Calc := 6.5;
END_IF;

(* Specific Enthalpy Approximations for Liquid, Vapor, and Latent Heat [kJ/kg] *)
rEvap_Liquid_Enthalpy := 200.0 + 4.65 * rEvap_Sat_Temp_Calc;
rEvap_Vapor_Enthalpy  := 1440.0 + 1.25 * rEvap_Sat_Temp_Calc;
rEvap_Latent_Heat_hfg := rEvap_Vapor_Enthalpy - rEvap_Liquid_Enthalpy;

rCond_Liquid_Enthalpy := 200.0 + 4.65 * rCond_Sat_Temp_Calc;
rCond_Vapor_Enthalpy  := 1440.0 + 1.25 * rCond_Sat_Temp_Calc;
rCond_Latent_Heat_hfg := rCond_Vapor_Enthalpy - rCond_Liquid_Enthalpy;

(* rho_warm = 1024 kg/m3, cp_warm = 3.99 kJ/(kg*K) *)
IF rFilt_WarmSeawater_Flow > 100.0 THEN
    rGross_Thermal_Power_In := (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Flow * 1024.0 / 3600.0) * 3.99 * 
                               MAX(0.1, (rVoted_WarmSeawater_Temp - rWarmSeawater_Discharge_Temp));
ELSE
    rGross_Thermal_Power_In := 1000.0;
END_IF;
rWarmSeawater_HeatTransfer_kW := rGross_Thermal_Power_In;

(* R717 Cycle Mass Flow Rate derived from Evaporator Heat Duty [kg/s] *)
IF rEvap_Latent_Heat_hfg > 500.0 THEN
    rAmmonia_Mass_Flow_kg_s := rGross_Thermal_Power_In / rEvap_Latent_Heat_hfg;

END_IF;

(* Cold Seawater Heat Rejection Rate [kW] *)
(* rho_cold = 1028 kg/m3, cp_cold = 4.05 kJ/(kg*K) *)
IF rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h > 100.0 THEN
    rCondenser_Heat_Rejection := (rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h * 1028.0 / 3600.0) * 4.05 * 
                                 MAX(0.1, (rColdSeawater_Discharge_Temp - rVoted_ColdSeawater_Temp));
ELSE
    rCondenser_Heat_Rejection := 900.0;
END_IF;
rColdSeawater_HeatRejection_kW := rCondenser_Heat_Rejection;

(* Turbine Enthalpy Expansion & Shaft Power Generation [kW] *)
rTurbine_Isentropic_EnthalpyDrop := MAX(10.0, rTurbine_Inlet_Enthalpy - rCond_Vapor_Enthalpy);
rTurbine_Actual_EnthalpyDrop     := rTurbine_Isentropic_EnthalpyDrop * rTurbine_Isentropic_Efficiency;
rTurbine_Mechanical_Power        := rAmmonia_Mass_Flow_kg_s * rTurbine_Actual_EnthalpyDrop;

(* Subcooling Margin in Condenser Hotwell [deg C] *)
rCondenser_Subcooling_Margin := rCond_Sat_Temp_Calc - rCondenser_Subcooling_Temp;

(* Cycle Thermodynamic Efficiencies [%] *)
IF (rVoted_WarmSeawater_Temp + 273.15) > 100.0 THEN
    rCarnot_Thermal_Eff := (1.0 - ((rVoted_ColdSeawater_Temp + 273.15) / (rVoted_WarmSeawater_Temp + 273.15))) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCarnot_Thermal_Eff := 7.0;
END_IF;

IF rGross_Thermal_Power_In > 5000.0 THEN
    rThermodynamic_Thermal_Eff := (MAX(0.0, (rGenerator_Active_Power - rAuxiliary_Parasitic_Power_kW)) / rGross_Thermal_Power_In) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rThermodynamic_Thermal_Eff := 0.0;
END_IF;


(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* LOGIC SECTION 4: 1,000-METER ABYSSAL CWIP HYDRODYNAMICS & 3-PUMP ACTIVE BALANCING    *)
(* Addresses Massive Fluid Column Inertia (6.33 Mt), Water Hammer, and Head Loss         *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Sum Total Cold Water Volumetric Intake Flow [m3/h] *)
rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h := rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump1 + rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump2 + rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump3;

(* Mean Flow Velocity inside 2.80m Bore Column [m/s] *)
rCWIP_Fluid_Velocity_mps := (rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h / 3600.0) / c_CWIP_FlowArea_m2;

(* Reynolds Number inside Abyssal Conduit *)
rCWIP_Reynolds_Number := (1028.0 * rCWIP_Fluid_Velocity_mps * c_CWIP_Diameter_m) / 0.00165;

(* Darcy-Weisbach Continuous Hydraulic Friction Head Loss [m] *)
rCWIP_Friction_HeadLoss_m := rCWIP_Darcy_Friction_Factor * (c_CWIP_Length_m / c_CWIP_Diameter_m) * 
                             ((rCWIP_Fluid_Velocity_mps * rCWIP_Fluid_Velocity_mps) / (2.0 * 9.80665));

(* Fluid Inertia Momentum Rate of Change [m3/h per s] *)
rCWIP_Dynamic_Inertia_dF_dt := (rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h - rCWIP_Last_Total_Flow_m3h) / c_Ts_CycleTime;
rCWIP_Last_Total_Flow_m3h := rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h;

(* Joukowsky Surge Head Pressure Monitoring & Anti-Cavitation Assessment [kPa] *)
rCWIP_Manifold_NPSHa_kPa := rFilt_CWIP_Top_Manifold_Press - 1.25 + 
                            ((1028.0 * rCWIP_Fluid_Velocity_mps * rCWIP_Fluid_Velocity_mps) / 2000.0);
rCWIP_Hydraulic_Head_Margin := rCWIP_Manifold_NPSHa_kPa - 35.0;

(* Parallel Pump Active Load-Balancing Network: Equalizing 3 Pumps to Flow Target *)
rCWIP_Target_Flow_Per_Pump_m3h := rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h / 3.0;

rPump1_Flow_Error := rCWIP_Target_Flow_Per_Pump_m3h - rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump1;
rPump2_Flow_Error := rCWIP_Target_Flow_Per_Pump_m3h - rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump2;
rPump3_Flow_Error := rCWIP_Target_Flow_Per_Pump_m3h - rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump3;

(* Integral Equalization Trims with Anti-Windup Clamping (-4.0% to +4.0%) *)
rPump1_PI_Integral := LIMIT(-4.0, (rPump1_PI_Integral + (0.00008 * rPump1_Flow_Error * c_Ts_CycleTime)), 4.0);
rPump2_PI_Integral := LIMIT(-4.0, (rPump2_PI_Integral + (0.00008 * rPump2_Flow_Error * c_Ts_CycleTime)), 4.0);
rPump3_PI_Integral := LIMIT(-4.0, (rPump3_PI_Integral + (0.00008 * rPump3_Flow_Error * c_Ts_CycleTime)), 4.0);

rPump1_Trim_Speed := (0.0006 * rPump1_Flow_Error) + rPump1_PI_Integral;
rPump2_Trim_Speed := (0.0006 * rPump2_Flow_Error) + rPump2_PI_Integral;
rPump3_Trim_Speed := (0.0006 * rPump3_Flow_Error) + rPump3_PI_Integral;

(* Individual Pump Speed References with Slew Limit to Prevent Water Hammer *)
rColdSeawater_Pump1_Speed_Cmd := LIMIT(0.0, (rColdMaster_Speed_Reference + rPump1_Trim_Speed), 100.0);
rColdSeawater_Pump2_Speed_Cmd := LIMIT(0.0, (rColdMaster_Speed_Reference + rPump2_Trim_Speed), 100.0);
rColdSeawater_Pump3_Speed_Cmd := LIMIT(0.0, (rColdMaster_Speed_Reference + rPump3_Trim_Speed), 100.0);


(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* LOGIC SECTION 5: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL & DISCRETE KALMAN/OBSERVER ESTIMATOR     *)
(* Sampling Ts = 50ms. States: [P_evap, Level_evap, Omega_turb, Flow_cwip]               *)
(* State Propagation: x_hat[k+1] = Ad * x_hat[k] + Bd * u[k] + L * (y[k] - Cd * x_hat[k])*)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate Output Residuals / Innovation Error: e_y = y_measured - Cd * x_hat *)
rObserverResidual_1 := rVoted_Evaporator_Press - (Cd_11 * rStateEst_P_evap);
rObserverResidual_2 := rEvaporator_Liquid_Level - (Cd_22 * rStateEst_Level_evap);
rObserverResidual_3 := rVoted_Turbine_Speed    - (Cd_33 * rStateEst_Omega_turb);
rObserverResidual_4 := rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h    - (Cd_44 * rStateEst_Flow_cwip);

(* Propagate Next State Vector via Discrete Matrices Ad, Bd, and Observer Gain L *)
rNextStateEst_P_evap := (Ad_11 * rStateEst_P_evap + Ad_12 * rStateEst_Level_evap + Ad_13 * rStateEst_Omega_turb + Ad_14 * rStateEst_Flow_cwip) +
                        (Bd_11 * rWarmPump_Demand_Accum + Bd_12 * rVIGV_Demand_Accum + Bd_13 * rColdPump_Demand_Accum) +
                        (L_11 * rObserverResidual_1 + L_12 * rObserverResidual_2 + L_13 * rObserverResidual_3 + L_14 * rObserverResidual_4);

rNextStateEst_Level_evap := (Ad_21 * rStateEst_P_evap + Ad_22 * rStateEst_Level_evap + Ad_23 * rStateEst_Omega_turb + Ad_24 * rStateEst_Flow_cwip) +
                            (Bd_21 * rWarmPump_Demand_Accum + Bd_22 * rVIGV_Demand_Accum + Bd_23 * rColdPump_Demand_Accum) +
                            (L_21 * rObserverResidual_1 + L_22 * rObserverResidual_2 + L_23 * rObserverResidual_3 + L_24 * rObserverResidual_4);

rNextStateEst_Omega_turb := (Ad_31 * rStateEst_P_evap + Ad_32 * rStateEst_Level_evap + Ad_33 * rStateEst_Omega_turb + Ad_34 * rStateEst_Flow_cwip) +
                            (Bd_31 * rWarmPump_Demand_Accum + Bd_32 * rVIGV_Demand_Accum + Bd_33 * rColdPump_Demand_Accum) +
                            (L_31 * rObserverResidual_1 + L_32 * rObserverResidual_2 + L_33 * rObserverResidual_3 + L_34 * rObserverResidual_4);

rNextStateEst_Flow_cwip := (Ad_41 * rStateEst_P_evap + Ad_42 * rStateEst_Level_evap + Ad_43 * rStateEst_Omega_turb + Ad_44 * rStateEst_Flow_cwip) +
                           (Bd_41 * rWarmPump_Demand_Accum + Bd_42 * rVIGV_Demand_Accum + Bd_43 * rColdPump_Demand_Accum) +
                           (L_41 * rObserverResidual_1 + L_42 * rObserverResidual_2 + L_43 * rObserverResidual_3 + L_44 * rObserverResidual_4);

(* State Vector Update with Physical Range Sanitization *)
rStateEst_P_evap     := LIMIT(5.0, rNextStateEst_P_evap, 14.0);
rStateEst_Level_evap := LIMIT(0.0, rNextStateEst_Level_evap, 100.0);
rStateEst_Omega_turb := LIMIT(0.0, rNextStateEst_Omega_turb, 3600.0);
rStateEst_Flow_cwip  := LIMIT(0.0, rNextStateEst_Flow_cwip, 25000.0);


(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* LOGIC SECTION 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) CONDENSED QUADRATIC SOLVER           *)
(* Solves: min 0.5 * Delta_u^T * H * Delta_u + g^T * Delta_u  s.t. Bounds & Slew Limits *)
(* Uses Projected Gradient Descent with Warm-Starting for Hard Real-Time Determinism    *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate Linear Gradient Vector g based on Tracking Errors *)
g_1 := 2.0 * (rQ_weight_1 * (rStateEst_P_evap - rMPC_Ref_P_evap) * 0.05 + 
              rQ_weight_2 * (rStateEst_Level_evap - rMPC_Ref_Level_evap) * 0.02 + 
              rQ_weight_3 * (rStateEst_Omega_turb - rMPC_Ref_Omega_turb) * 0.01);

g_2 := 2.0 * (rQ_weight_1 * (rStateEst_P_evap - rMPC_Ref_P_evap) * (-0.04) + 
              rQ_weight_2 * (rStateEst_Level_evap - rMPC_Ref_Level_evap) * (-0.06) + 
              rQ_weight_3 * (rStateEst_Omega_turb - rMPC_Ref_Omega_turb) * 0.25);

g_3 := 2.0 * (rQ_weight_4 * (rStateEst_Flow_cwip - rMPC_Ref_Flow_cwip) * 0.08);

(* Initialize Control Adjustment Step *)
Delta_u_1 := 0.0;
Delta_u_2 := 0.0;
Delta_u_3 := 0.0;

(* Iterative Projected Gradient Descent Optimization Loop *)
FOR iMpcIteration := 1 TO 8 DO
    (* Gradient Evaluation: Grad = H * Delta_u + g *)
    rGrad_1 := (H_11 * Delta_u_1 + H_12 * Delta_u_2 + H_13 * Delta_u_3) + g_1;
    rGrad_2 := (H_21 * Delta_u_1 + H_22 * Delta_u_2 + H_23 * Delta_u_3) + g_2;
    rGrad_3 := (H_31 * Delta_u_1 + H_32 * Delta_u_2 + H_33 * Delta_u_3) + g_3;

    (* Gradient Descent Step *)
    Delta_u_1 := Delta_u_1 - (rMpcAlpha * rGrad_1);
    Delta_u_2 := Delta_u_2 - (rMpcAlpha * rGrad_2);
    Delta_u_3 := Delta_u_3 - (rMpcAlpha * rGrad_3);

    (* Actuator Slew Rate Projection / Clamping *)
    Delta_u_1 := LIMIT(-0.45, Delta_u_1, 0.45);  (* Warm Pump Max Slew [%/cycle] *)
    Delta_u_2 := LIMIT(-1.20, Delta_u_2, 1.20);  (* VIGV Servo Max Slew [%/cycle] *)
    Delta_u_3 := LIMIT(-0.35, Delta_u_3, 0.35);  (* Cold Pump Anti-Hammer Slew [%/cycle] *)
END_FOR;

(* Apply MPC Solution in Active Automatic Baseload Generating States *)
IF (iCurrentSequenceState = 80) OR (iCurrentSequenceState = 85) THEN
    rWarmPump_Demand_Accum := LIMIT(20.0, (rWarmPump_Demand_Accum + Delta_u_1), 100.0);
    rVIGV_Demand_Accum     := LIMIT(10.0, (rVIGV_Demand_Accum + Delta_u_2), 100.0);
    rColdPump_Demand_Accum := LIMIT(20.0, (rColdPump_Demand_Accum + Delta_u_3), 100.0);
    rColdMaster_Speed_Reference := rColdPump_Demand_Accum;
END_IF;


(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* LOGIC SECTION 7: RADIAL INFLOW TURBINE GOVERNOR & CRITICAL RESONANCE AVOIDANCE       *)
(* Incorporates Rotor Critical Speed Skip Bands, Anti-Stall VIGV, and Grid Speed Droop   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Identify Rotor Mechanical Critical Resonance Bands *)
bInResonance_Band_1 := (rVoted_Turbine_Speed >= 1150.0) AND (rVoted_Turbine_Speed <= 1350.0);
bInResonance_Band_2 := (rVoted_Turbine_Speed >= 2150.0) AND (rVoted_Turbine_Speed <= 2350.0);

(* Acceleration Slew Generation with Dynamic Resonance Band Fast Skip *)
IF bInResonance_Band_1 OR bInResonance_Band_2 THEN
    rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint := rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint + (rResonance_Fast_Ramp_Rate * c_Ts_CycleTime);
ELSIF rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint < c_TurbineRatedSpeed_RPM THEN
    IF iCurrentSequenceState = 60 THEN
        rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint := rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint + (rTurbine_Speed_Ramp_Rate * c_Ts_CycleTime);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF iCurrentSequenceState >= 70 THEN
    rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint := c_TurbineRatedSpeed_RPM;
END_IF;

(* Closed-Loop PID Speed Governor Calculation *)
rSpeedGov_Error := rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint - rVoted_Turbine_Speed;

rSpeedGov_P_Term := rSpeedGov_Kp * rSpeedGov_Error;

(* Integral Term with Anti-Windup Reset Clamping *)
rSpeedGov_I_Term := LIMIT(-30.0, (rSpeedGov_I_Term + (rSpeedGov_Kp / rSpeedGov_Ti * rSpeedGov_Error * c_Ts_CycleTime)), 30.0);

(* Derivative Term with Low-Pass Filtering *)
rSpeedGov_D_Term := (rSpeedGov_Kp * rSpeedGov_Td) * ((rVoted_Turbine_Speed - rSpeedGov_LastSpeed) / c_Ts_CycleTime);
rSpeedGov_LastSpeed := rVoted_Turbine_Speed;

rSpeedGov_Output := LIMIT(0.0, (rSpeedGov_P_Term + rSpeedGov_I_Term - rSpeedGov_D_Term), 100.0);

(* Speed Droop Regulation when Generator is Paralleled to Grid *)
IF iCurrentSequenceState >= 80 THEN
    (* 3.0% Droop: 100% Load shift for 1.5 Hz frequency change *)
    rVIGV_Command := LIMIT(15.0, (rVIGV_Demand_Accum - ((rVoted_Turbine_Speed - c_TurbineRatedSpeed_RPM) / (c_TurbineRatedSpeed_RPM * (rDroop_Gain_Percent / 100.0)) * 100.0)), 100.0);
ELSIF iCurrentSequenceState >= 60 THEN
    rVIGV_Command := LIMIT(5.0, rSpeedGov_Output, 65.0);
ELSE
    rVIGV_Command := 0.0;
END_IF;


(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* LOGIC SECTION 8: AUTOMATIC SYNCHROCHECK RELAY & ELECTRICAL BUS COUPLING              *)
(* Monitors Voltage RMS, Frequency Slip, and Phase Angle Displacement                  *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate Deviations between Generator Terminals and Offshore Utility Substation *)
rSynch_Voltage_Diff_Percent  := (ABS(rGen_Voltage_RMS - rGrid_Voltage_RMS) / c_GridNominalVoltage_V) * 100.0;
rSynch_Frequency_Slip_Hz     := ABS(rGen_Frequency_Hz - rGrid_Frequency_Hz);
rSynch_Phase_Angle_Error_Deg := ABS(rGen_Phase_Angle_Deg - rGrid_Phase_Angle_Deg);

(* Synchrocheck Permissive Window Assessment *)
bSynch_Voltage_OK := (rSynch_Voltage_Diff_Percent <= 2.0);
bSynch_Slip_OK    := (rSynch_Frequency_Slip_Hz <= 0.05);
bSynch_Phase_OK   := (rSynch_Phase_Angle_Error_Deg <= 5.0);

bSynch_AllPermissivesMet := bSynch_Voltage_OK AND bSynch_Slip_OK AND bSynch_Phase_OK AND bGrid_Tie_Permissive;

(* Continuous Dwell Time Verification Timer (500 ms) *)
tSynchDwellTimer(IN := (bSynch_AllPermissivesMet AND (iCurrentSequenceState = 70)), PT := T#500MS);

tBreakerClosePulseTimer(IN := tSynchDwellTimer.Q, PT := T#250MS);

(* LOGIC SECTION 9: MASTER PLANT FINITE STATE MACHINE (11 SEQUENCE STATES)              *)
(* Coordinates System Startup, CWP Priming, Bootstrap, Synchronization, and Shutdown   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Detect State Transitions for Timer Resets *)
bStateFirstScan := (iCurrentSequenceState <> iLastSequenceState);
iLastSequenceState := iCurrentSequenceState;

CASE iCurrentSequenceState OF

    0: (* STATE 0: IDLE / UNINITIALIZED *)
        bTurbine_Trip_Valve_FastClose := FALSE;
        rVIGV_Command                 := 0.0;
        rWarmSeawater_Pump_Speed_Cmd  := 0.0;
        rColdSeawater_Pump1_Speed_Cmd := 0.0;
        rColdSeawater_Pump2_Speed_Cmd := 0.0;
        rColdSeawater_Pump3_Speed_Cmd := 0.0;
        rAmmonia_Feed_Pump_Speed_Cmd  := 0.0;
        rEvaporator_Bypass_Valve_Cmd  := 0.0;
        rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint       := 0.0;

        IF bMaster_Enable AND bSafety_Relay_Loop_OK AND (NOT bLatched_Emergency_Trip) THEN
            iCurrentSequenceState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: STANDBY READY *)
        bTurbine_Trip_Valve_FastClose := FALSE;
        rVIGV_Command                 := 0.0;
        rEvaporator_Bypass_Valve_Cmd  := 100.0; (* Full open bypass to equalize pressures *)

        IF bMaster_Enable AND (rFilt_Ammonia_Sniffer_PPM < c_AmmoniaToxicThreshold_PPM) THEN
            iCurrentSequenceState := 20;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: SAFETY SURVEILLANCE & PRE-START VERIFICATION *)
        tStateStepTimer(IN := NOT bStateFirstScan, PT := T#10S);
        IF tStateStepTimer.Q THEN
            tStateStepTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iCurrentSequenceState := 30;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: 1,000M ABYSSAL CWIP SLOW PRIMING & SURGE SUPPRESSION *)
        (* Controlled gradual acceleration of 6.33 Mt water column *)
        rColdMaster_Speed_Reference := LIMIT(0.0, (rColdMaster_Speed_Reference + 0.15), 45.0);
        IF rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h > 10000.0 THEN
            iCurrentSequenceState := 40;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: SEAWATER HYDRAULIC CIRCULATION BALANCING *)
        rWarmSeawater_Pump_Speed_Cmd := LIMIT(0.0, (rWarmSeawater_Pump_Speed_Cmd + 0.25), 65.0);
        rColdMaster_Speed_Reference  := LIMIT(0.0, (rColdMaster_Speed_Reference + 0.20), 65.0);
        IF (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Flow > 20000.0) AND (rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h > 15000.0) THEN
            iCurrentSequenceState := 50;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: AMMONIA WORKING FLUID EVAPORATION BOOTSTRAP *)
        rAmmonia_Feed_Pump_Speed_Cmd := LIMIT(0.0, (rAmmonia_Feed_Pump_Speed_Cmd + 0.30), 60.0);
        rEvaporator_Bypass_Valve_Cmd := 80.0;
        IF (rVoted_Evaporator_Press >= 8.5) AND (rVoted_Condenser_Press <= 6.0) THEN

        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: RADIAL INFLOW TURBINE WARM-UP & ACCELERATION *)
        bTurbine_Trip_Valve_FastClose := TRUE; (* Energize trip valve to open *)
        rEvaporator_Bypass_Valve_Cmd  := LIMIT(10.0, (rEvaporator_Bypass_Valve_Cmd - 0.20), 100.0);
        IF rVoted_Turbine_Speed >= (c_TurbineRatedSpeed_RPM - 15.0) THEN
            iCurrentSequenceState := 70;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: AUTO GRID SYNCHRONIZATION *)
        IF bGenerator_Breaker_Close_Cmd THEN
            iCurrentSequenceState := 80;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE 80: BASELOAD ON-GRID MPC OPTIMIZED GENERATION *)
        bTurbine_Trip_Valve_FastClose := TRUE;
        rEvaporator_Bypass_Valve_Cmd  := 0.0;
        rWarmSeawater_Pump_Speed_Cmd  := rWarmPump_Demand_Accum;
        rAmmonia_Feed_Pump_Speed_Cmd  := 85.0;

            iCurrentSequenceState := 85;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bMaster_Enable THEN
            iCurrentSequenceState := 90;
        END_IF;

    85: (* STATE 85: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION DERATED CAPACITY *)
        bTurbine_Trip_Valve_FastClose := TRUE;
        rWarmSeawater_Pump_Speed_Cmd  := rWarmPump_Demand_Accum * 0.85;
        rColdMaster_Speed_Reference   := rColdPump_Demand_Accum * 0.85;
        bDegraded_Mode_Active         := TRUE;

        IF NOT bMaster_Enable THEN
            iCurrentSequenceState := 90;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: CONTROLLED RAMP-DOWN SHUTDOWN SEQUENCE *)
        rVIGV_Command                := LIMIT(0.0, (rVIGV_Command - 0.50), 100.0);
        rEvaporator_Bypass_Valve_Cmd := LIMIT(0.0, (rEvaporator_Bypass_Valve_Cmd + 1.0), 100.0);
        rWarmSeawater_Pump_Speed_Cmd := LIMIT(0.0, (rWarmSeawater_Pump_Speed_Cmd - 0.20), 100.0);
        rColdMaster_Speed_Reference  := LIMIT(0.0, (rColdMaster_Speed_Reference - 0.15), 100.0);
        rAmmonia_Feed_Pump_Speed_Cmd := LIMIT(0.0, (rAmmonia_Feed_Pump_Speed_Cmd - 0.40), 100.0);

        IF (rVIGV_Command <= 1.0) AND (rVoted_Turbine_Speed < 200.0) THEN
            bTurbine_Trip_Valve_FastClose := FALSE;
            iCurrentSequenceState := 0;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE 99: EMERGENCY TRIP LOCKOUT *)
        bTurbine_Trip_Valve_FastClose := FALSE; (* Instantaneous De-energize Rapid Trip *)
        rVIGV_Command                 := 0.0;
        rEvaporator_Bypass_Valve_Cmd  := 100.0; (* Full open bypass to protect shell *)
        rAmmonia_Feed_Pump_Speed_Cmd  := 0.0;
        rWarmSeawater_Pump_Speed_Cmd  := LIMIT(0.0, (rWarmSeawater_Pump_Speed_Cmd - 0.5), 100.0);
        rColdMaster_Speed_Reference   := LIMIT(0.0, (rColdMaster_Speed_Reference - 0.2), 100.0);

        IF bAck_Alarm AND (NOT bLatched_Emergency_Trip) AND bSafety_Relay_Loop_OK THEN
            iCurrentSequenceState := 0;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* LOGIC SECTION 10: 4-TIER HIERARCHICAL SAFETY ALARM & TRIP SYSTEM                    *)
(* Evaluates Catastrophic Process Excursions and Latches First-Out Trip Memory          *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Class 1: Instantaneous Emergency Trip Triggers *)
bTrip_Overspeed             := (rVoted_Turbine_Speed >= c_TurbineOverspeedTrip_RPM);
bTrip_Evaporator_HighPress  := (rVoted_Evaporator_Press >= c_EvapPressureMaxTrip_bar);
bTrip_Condenser_HighPress   := (rVoted_Condenser_Press >= c_CondPressureMaxTrip_bar);
bTrip_ToxicGasContainment   := (rFilt_Ammonia_Sniffer_PPM >= c_AmmoniaFatalThreshold_PPM);
bTrip_CWIP_SurgeWaterHammer := (rFilt_CWIP_Bottom_Surge_Press >= 250.0);
bTrip_HighVibrationTrip     := (rTurbine_Vibration_X_um >= 45.0) OR (rTurbine_Vibration_Y_um >= 45.0);
bTrip_BearingOverheat       := (rTurbine_Thrust_Bearing_Temp >= 85.0);
bTrip_SafetyRelayLoopOpen   := NOT bSafety_Relay_Loop_OK;

(* Latch Global Emergency Trip and Record First-Out Diagnostic Code *)
IF (NOT bLatched_Emergency_Trip) THEN
    IF bTrip_Overspeed THEN
        bLatched_Emergency_Trip := TRUE;
        iFirstOutFaultCode := 101;
        iCurrentSequenceState := 99;
    ELSIF bTrip_Evaporator_HighPress THEN
        bLatched_Emergency_Trip := TRUE;
        iFirstOutFaultCode := 102;
        iCurrentSequenceState := 99;
    ELSIF bTrip_Condenser_HighPress THEN
        bLatched_Emergency_Trip := TRUE;
        iFirstOutFaultCode := 103;
        iCurrentSequenceState := 99;
